title: Festive promotion
blurb: Your product dressed for the season with your offer written in, in feed, portrait and story sizes, plus a camera move for Reels.

inputs.label: Product photo
inputs.help: Any clear photo of the product on its own.

inputs.label: Your offer, in a few words

values.prompt: Place this product on a festive table decorated for {{occasion}}, warm celebratory light. Keep the product exactly as it is.
Add the words “{{offer}}” in large, bold, legible letters near the top, in colours that suit {{occasion}}. Keep everything else exactly as it is.
